name: pi-vision-tool
description: Pi extension: automatic image-to-text bridge (user messages + tool results + TUI paste) plus a describe_image tool, routed through pi's official pipeline. Zero-config auto-discovery, configurable resizeImage compression, multi-format support (HEIC/HEIF/AVIF/TIFF/SVG via conversion), and vision-cache paths so the model can re-verify images with different prompts.
author: ptbsare
